scope: Only preselected compressed cases that fail the initial complete convergence gate. No neural refit, case replacement, posterior reweighting or truth-dependent selection.
proposal: Use failed phase solely as a pilot for latent-z mean/covariance. Freeze a 75% mixture of independence-t/local-Gaussian MH and 25% angle-prior refresh with conditional 8D Student-t proposal. Include exact component-wise Hastings ratios and normal density of proposed z_PA. Each component separately preserves the identical compressed likelihood and prior.
gate: Same complete physical target/nuisance/PA sin/cos/log-likelihood rank-folded Rhat<1.01, bulk and tail ESS>=400, four chains; no posterior use otherwise.
phase_policy: Retain initial raw chains, failures and timing. Start four chains at their own saved states, warm up under the frozen new kernel and assess new production alone; do not pool heterogeneous phases. One refresh phase per failed case, subject to 13:30 UTC science stop. Count all earlier work in total runtime. No threshold relaxation.
